2609.13500.title: One Spectrum, Two Resources: Data-Memory Scaling in Autoregressive Prediction
2609.13500.paper_summary: How much learned memory is needed to benefit from more data? We show that the two resources are governed by one predictive-energy spectrum in a positive-entropy autoregressive retrieval source. Each coordinate contributes its query probability times the squared radius of its unknown logit. Writing $μ$ for the resulting energy spectrum, we prove the minimax law $\mathfrak R^*_{\rm value}(n,B)\asymp_R Φ_μ(n^{-1})+Φ_μ(τ_B), Φ_μ(t)=\int\min\{x,t\}\,μ(\mathrm dx),$ for $n$ prediction blocks and a learned state with at most $2^B$ values. Data set the resolution $1/n$; memory sets the level $τ_B$ reached by optimal bit allocation. The complete curve also recovers the positive spectrum. Energy-dimension pairing is essential: two causal sources with identical block-energy and block-dimension marginals have different data and memory exponents. A masked query-key attention head learns the route and values, realizing the law with explicit routing, format, and arithmetic errors. Further results give exponent-adaptive allocation, finite-precision realization, and compute-precision laws under two-sided arithmetic assumptions. Experiments recover the data-memory collapse and coupling exponents, explain the routing and allocation mechanisms, and examine weight-only quantization across six pretrained-model scales.
2609.13500.paper_summary_zh: 需要多少學習記憶才能從更多數據中受益？我們展示了這兩種資源由一個正熵自回歸檢索源中的預測能量譜所主導。每個坐標貢獻其查詢概率乘以其未知邏輯的平方半徑。用 $μ$ 表示結果能量譜，我們證明了最小最大法則 $\mathfrak R^*_{\rm value}(n,B)\asymp_R Φ_μ(n^{-1})+Φ_μ(τ_B), Φ_μ(t)=\int\min\{x,t\}\,μ(\mathrm dx),$ 針對 $n$ 個預測區塊和最多有 $2^B$ 個值的學習狀態。數據設定了解析度 $1/n$；記憶設置了通過最佳位元分配達到的水平 $τ_B$。完整的曲線也恢復了正譜。能量維度配對是至關重要的：兩個具有相同區塊能量和區塊維度邊際的因果源擁有不同的數據和記憶指數。一個掩碼查詢鍵注意頭學習路徑和數值，通過明確的路由、格式和算術錯誤實現法律。進一步的結果提供了指數自適應分配、有限精度實現以及在雙側算術假設下的計算精度法則。實驗恢復了數據-記憶崩潰和耦合指數，解釋了路由和分配機制，並檢查了跨六個預訓練模型尺度的僅權重量化。
2609.13500.author: Chiwun Yang et.al.
